qa_pairs.question: Which engine type uses M8 screws with 17 Nm torque for the oil trap to cylinder head cover?
Which components in section 11.12 use M7 screws?
qa_pairs.answer: Cylinder head cover and timing case to cylinder head

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M8 screws for the oil trap and timing case connections?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil trap uses 17 Nm while the timing case uses 20 Nm
